  (function () {

    // -----------------------------
    function logError(message) {

        console.error(message);

          brandId: BRAND_ID,

        });
        if (typeof fetch === "function") {

          }).catch(function () {});

        console.error("Error in logging error");
      }
    }

    // Bot Check
    // -----------------------------
    try {
      const crawlerRegexAbScript = /googlebot|google-inspectiontool|google-extended|bingbot|adsbot-google|googleother|storebot-google|mediapartners-google|gptbot|chatgpt-user|oai-searchbot|claudebot|claude-user|claude-searchbot|anthropic-ai|perplexitybot|perplexity-user|facebookbot|meta-externalagent|duckduckbot|duckassistbot|applebot|applebot-extended|amazonbot|bytespider|ccbot|linkedinbot|baiduspider|yandexbot|sogou|exabot|ia_archiver|bot/i;
      function isCrawlerUserAgentAbScript() {
        const ua = (navigator.userAgent || '').toLowerCase();
        const isCrawler = crawlerRegexAbScript.test(ua);
        return isCrawler;

        return;

    } catch (e) {
      logError("Error in checking bot")
    }

    // -----------------------------
    // Get Shopify Theme Context
    // -----------------------------
    function getShopifyTheme() {
      try {
        const shopifyTheme = (window.Shopify && Shopify.theme);

          return {};

        return shopifyTheme;
      } catch (e) {
        logError("Error in getting Shopify theme context");
        return {};
      }
    }

    // -----------------------------
    // Storage Helper
    // -----------------------------
    function storage(storageType, operation, key, value) {
      try {
        return operation === "get" ? storageType.getItem(key) : storageType.setItem(key, value);
      } catch (e) {
        logError(`${storageType} unavailable`);
        return null;
      }
    }

    // -----------------------------
    // Cookie Helper
    // -----------------------------
    function setCookie(name, value, ttlMinutes) {
      try {
        const expires = new Date(Date.now() + ttlMinutes * 60 * 1000).toUTCString();
        document.cookie = `${name}=${encodeURIComponent(value)}; expires=${expires}; path=/; SameSite=Lax`;
      } catch (e) {
        logError("Failed to set cookie");
      }
    }

    function getCookie(name) {
      try {
        const match = document.cookie.match(
          new RegExp("(^|; )" + name.replace(/([.$?*|{}()[\]\\/+^])/g, "\\$1") + "=([^;]*)"),
        );
        return match ? decodeURIComponent(match[2]) : null;
      } catch (e) {
        logError("Failed to get cookie");
        return null;
      }
    }

    // -----------------------------
    // UUID Generator
    // -----------------------------
    function generateUUID() {
      try {
        if (typeof crypto !== "undefined" && crypto.randomUUID) {
          return crypto.randomUUID();
        }
        if (typeof crypto !== "undefined" && crypto.getRandomValues) {
          return ([1e7] + -1e3 + -4e3 + -8e3 + -1e11).replace(/[018]/g, function (c) {
            return (c ^ (crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(1))[0] & (15 >> (c / 4)))).toString(16);
          });
        }
        return "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx".replace(/[xy]/g, function (c) {

        logError("UUID generation failed");

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

    document.querySelectorAll(".st-search-box").forEach(searchBox => {

        const input = searchBox.querySelector(".st-search-input");
        const clearBtn = searchBox.querySelector(".st-input-action-btn");

        if (!input || !clearBtn) return;

        function toggleClearButton() {
            clearBtn.style.display = input.value.trim() ? "block" : "";
        }

        toggleClearButton();

        input.addEventListener("input", toggleClearButton);

        clearBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
            input.value = "";
            input.focus();

            input.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
            input.dispatchEvent(new Event("change", { bubbles: true }));
            input.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keyup", {
                key: "Backspace",
                bubbles: true
            }));
        });

    });

});

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

    document.querySelectorAll(".st-search-box").forEach(searchBox => {

        const input = searchBox.querySelector(".st-search-input");
        const clearBtn = searchBox.querySelector(".st-input-action-btn");

        if (!input || !clearBtn) return;

        function toggleClearButton() {
            clearBtn.style.display = input.value.trim() ? "block" : "";
        }

        toggleClearButton();

        input.addEventListener("input", toggleClearButton);

        clearBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
            input.value = "";
            input.focus();

            input.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
            input.dispatchEvent(new Event("change", { bubbles: true }));
            input.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keyup", {
                key: "Backspace",
                bubbles: true
            }));
        });

    });

});
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    const input = document.getElementById("st-search-mobile");
    const clearBtn = document.querySelector(".st-input-action-btn");

    if (!input || !clearBtn) return;

    function toggleClearButton() {
        if (input.value.trim()) {
            clearBtn.style.display = "block";
        } else {
            clearBtn.style.display = "";
        }
    }

    toggleClearButton();

    input.addEventListener("input", toggleClearButton);

    clearBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
        input.value = "";
        input.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
        input.focus();
    });
});
document.addEventListener("stSearchResultsEvent", function (e) {
    if (e.detail.source === "searchPage") {

            top: 0,
            behavior: "smooth"
        });
    }
});

<script>
  // Variant Sale Timer - Unified Global Implementation
  (function () {
    'use strict';

    // Create or use existing global timer function
    if (!window.variantSaleTimerInit) {
      window.variantSaleTimerInit = function () {
        const timers = document.querySelectorAll('.variant-sale-timer');

        timers.forEach(function (timer) {
          // Skip if already has an active interval
          if (timer.dataset.timerActive === 'true') {
            return;
          }

          const timerSpan = timer.querySelector('span[data-sale-timestamp]');
          if (!timerSpan) return;

          const saleTimestamp = parseInt(timerSpan.getAttribute('data-sale-timestamp')) * 1000;

          // Validate timestamp
          if (isNaN(saleTimestamp) || saleTimestamp <= 0) {
            return;
          }

          // Check if sale has already ended
          if (saleTimestamp <= Date.now()) {
            timer.style.display = 'none';
            const variantContents = timer.closest('.variant-contents');
            if (variantContents) {
              const stockDiv = variantContents.querySelector('.variant-avalability:not(.sale-timer)');
              if (stockDiv) stockDiv.style.display = 'block';
            }
            return;
          }

          // Mark as active
          timer.dataset.timerActive = 'true';

          function updateTimer() {
            const now = Date.now();
            const distance = saleTimestamp - now;

            if (distance <= 0) {
              timer.style.display = 'none';
              timer.dataset.timerActive = 'false';
              const variantContents = timer.closest('.variant-contents');
              if (variantContents) {
                const stockDiv = variantContents.querySelector('.variant-avalability:not(.sale-timer)');
                if (stockDiv) stockDiv.style.display = 'block';
              }
              return false;
            }

            const totalHours = Math.floor(distance / (1000 * 60 * 60));
            const minutes = Math.floor((distance % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
            const seconds = Math.floor((distance % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);

            timerSpan.textContent = `${totalHours}h : ${minutes}m : ${seconds}s`;
            return true;
          }

          // Initial update
          if (updateTimer()) {
            // Start interval
            setInterval(function () {
              if (!updateTimer()) {
                // Timer will stop itself when updateTimer returns false
              }
            }, 1000);
          }
        });
      };

      // Set up one-time global mutation observer
      if (typeof window.variantTimerObserver === 'undefined' && typeof MutationObserver !== 'undefined') {
        window.variantTimerObserver = new MutationObserver(function (mutations) {
          let shouldReinit = false;

          for (let i = 0; i < mutations.length; i++) {
            const mutation = mutations[i];
            if (mutation.addedNodes.length) {
              for (let j = 0; j < mutation.addedNodes.length; j++) {
                const node = mutation.addedNodes[j];
                if (node.nodeType === 1) {
                  // Element node
                  if (node.classList && node.classList.contains('product-variant-container')) {
                    shouldReinit = true;
                    break;
                  }
                  if (node.querySelector && node.querySelector('.product-variant-container')) {
                    shouldReinit = true;
                    break;
                  }
                }
              }
            }
            if (shouldReinit) break;
          }

          if (shouldReinit) {
            setTimeout(window.variantSaleTimerInit, 200);
          }
        });

        window.variantTimerObserver.observe(document.body, {
          childList: true,
          subtree: true,
        });
      }
    }

    // Initialize timers
    function init() {
      if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', window.variantSaleTimerInit);
      } else {
        window.variantSaleTimerInit();
      }
    }

    // Run initialization
    init();

    // Fallback: run after a delay to catch late-rendered content
    setTimeout(window.variantSaleTimerInit, 800);
  })();
</script>

      const loader = container.querySelector('.edd-loader');
      const resultDiv = container.querySelector('.edd-result');
      const inputSection = container.querySelector('.edd-input-section');
      const resultSection = container.querySelector('.edd-result-section');
      const updateLocationBtn = container.querySelector('.edd-update-location');
      const checkBtn = container.querySelector('.edd-check-btn');

      initReturnTooltip(container);

      if (!pincodeInput || !loader || !resultDiv || !inputSection || !resultSection) return;

      const customerPincode = container.getAttribute('data-customer-pincode') || '';

      if (customerPincode && customerPincode.length === 6) {
        checkDeliveryWithPincode(customerPincode);
      } else {
        loadSavedDeliveryData();
      }

      pincodeInput.addEventListener('input', function () {
        this.value = this.value.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');
        if (resultDiv.style.display === 'block') {
          resultDiv.style.display = 'none';
        }
      });

      if (checkBtn) {
        checkBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
          checkDelivery();
        });
      }

      pincodeInput.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {
        if (event.key === 'Enter') {
          event.preventDefault();
          checkDelivery();
        }
      });

      if (updateLocationBtn) {
        updateLocationBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
          const cardHeader = container.querySelector('.edd-card-header');
          const resultHeader = container.querySelector('.edd-result-header');
          if (cardHeader) cardHeader.style.display = 'block';
          if (resultHeader) resultHeader.style.display = 'none';
          resultSection.style.display = 'none';
          inputSection.style.display = 'flex';
          pincodeInput.value = '';
          pincodeInput.placeholder = 'Enter your pincode';
          window.EDDService.clearDeliveryData();
          pincodeInput.focus();
        });
      }

      function checkDelivery() {
        checkDeliveryWithPincode(pincodeInput.value.trim());
      }

      function checkDeliveryWithPincode(pincode) {
        if (!pincode || pincode.length !== 6) {
          showResult('Please enter a valid 6-digit pincode', 'error');
          return;
        }

        loader.classList.add('active');
        pincodeInput.classList.add('loading');
        pincodeInput.disabled = true;

        window.EDDService.fetchDeliveryEstimate(pincode)
          .then(function (data) {
            if (data && data.deliveryDate) {
              window.EDDService.saveDeliveryData(data);
              var city =
                data.fullResponse && data.fullResponse.data && data.fullResponse.data.city
                  ? data.fullResponse.data.city
                  : '';
              showDeliveryResult(data, pincode, city);
            } else {
              showResult('Unable to get delivery estimate. Please try again.', 'error');
            }
          })
          .catch(function (error) {
            console.error('Error checking delivery:', error);
            const errorMessage = error.message || 'Unable to check delivery right now. Please try again.';
            showResult(errorMessage, 'error');
          })
          .finally(function () {
            loader.classList.remove('active');
            pincodeInput.classList.remove('loading');
            pincodeInput.disabled = false;
          });
      }

      function showResult(message, type) {
        resultDiv.textContent = message;
        resultDiv.className = 'edd-result ' + type;
        resultDiv.style.display = 'block';
      }

      function showDeliveryResult(data, pincode, city) {
        const deliveryDate = data.deliveryDate || '';
        const deliveryDateEl = container.querySelector('.edd-delivery-date');
        const pincodeDisplayEl = container.querySelector('.edd-pincode-display');
        const cityDisplayEl = container.querySelector('.edd-city');
        const resultTitlePincode = container.querySelector('.edd-result-title-pincode');
        const cardHeader = container.querySelector('.edd-card-header');
        const resultHeader = container.querySelector('.edd-result-header');

        if (deliveryDateEl) deliveryDateEl.textContent = deliveryDate;
        if (pincodeDisplayEl) pincodeDisplayEl.textContent = pincode;
        if (cityDisplayEl) cityDisplayEl.textContent = city || '';
        if (resultTitlePincode) resultTitlePincode.textContent = pincode;

        if (cardHeader) cardHeader.style.display = 'none';
        if (resultHeader) resultHeader.style.display = 'block';
        inputSection.style.display = 'none';
        resultSection.style.display = 'flex';
      }

      function loadSavedDeliveryData() {
        const savedData = window.EDDService.loadDeliveryData();

        if (savedData && savedData.pincode && savedData.deliveryDate) {
          var city =
            savedData.fullResponse && savedData.fullResponse.data && savedData.fullResponse.data.city
              ? savedData.fullResponse.data.city
              : '';
          showDeliveryResult(savedData, savedData.pincode, city);
        }
      }
    }

    function initReturnTooltip(container) {
      const tooltip = container.querySelector('.edd-return-tooltip');
      if (!tooltip) return;

      const btn = tooltip.querySelector('.edd-return-tooltip-btn');
      if (!btn) return;

      function closeTooltip() {
        tooltip.classList.remove('is-open');
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      }

      btn.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();

        const willOpen = !tooltip.classList.contains('is-open');
        tooltip.classList.toggle('is-open', willOpen);
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', willOpen ? 'true' : 'false');

        if (willOpen && window.dataLayer) {
          window.dataLayer.push({ event: 'pdp_return_click', platform: 'web' });
        }
      });

      document.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
        if (!tooltip.contains(event.target)) closeTooltip();
      });

      document.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {
        if (event.key === 'Escape') closeTooltip();
      });
    }

    function initEDDPDP() {
      if (typeof window.EDDService === 'undefined') {
        setTimeout(initEDDPDP, 100);
        return;
      }

      document.querySelectorAll('.edd-pdp-container').forEach(initEddContainer);
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initEDDPDP);
    } else {
      initEDDPDP();
    }
  })();
</script>

<script>
  (function () {
    if (!window.reelVariantSaleTimerInit) {
      window.reelVariantSaleTimerInit = function () {
        const timers = document.querySelectorAll(
          '.reel-v-ribbon .variant-sale-timer, .reel-lip-sale-badge.variant-sale-timer'
        );
        timers.forEach(function (timer) {
          if (timer.dataset.timerActive === 'true') return;
          const timerSpan = timer.querySelector('span[data-sale-timestamp]');
          if (!timerSpan) return;
          const saleTimestamp = parseInt(timerSpan.getAttribute('data-sale-timestamp')) * 1000;
          if (isNaN(saleTimestamp) || saleTimestamp <= 0 || saleTimestamp <= Date.now()) {
            timer.style.display = 'none';
            return;
          }
          timer.dataset.timerActive = 'true';
          function updateTimer() {
            const now = Date.now();
            const distance = saleTimestamp - now;
            if (distance <= 0) {
              timer.style.display = 'none';
              timer.dataset.timerActive = 'false';
              return false;
            }
            const totalHours = Math.floor(distance / (1000 * 60 * 60));
            const minutes = Math.floor((distance % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
            const seconds = Math.floor((distance % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
            timerSpan.textContent = totalHours + 'h : ' + minutes + 'm : ' + seconds + 's';
            return true;
          }
          if (updateTimer()) {
            setInterval(function () {
              updateTimer();
            }, 1000);
          }
        });
      };
    }
    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', window.reelVariantSaleTimerInit);
    } else {
      window.reelVariantSaleTimerInit();
    }
  })();
</script>

  <script>
    (function () {
      const reelsWrapper = document.querySelector('.creator-reels-wrapper');
      if (!reelsWrapper || reelsWrapper.dataset.creatorReelsInit === '1') return;
      reelsWrapper.dataset.creatorReelsInit = '1';

      const carousel = reelsWrapper.querySelector('.creator-reels__carousel');
      const videoWrappers = reelsWrapper.querySelectorAll('.creator-reels__video-wrapper');
      const carouselVideos = reelsWrapper.querySelectorAll('.creator-reels__video');
      const popup = document.getElementById('creatorReelsPopup');
      const closeBtn = popup.querySelector('.creator-reels__popup-close');
      const slidesContainer = popup.querySelector('.creator-reels__popup-slides');
      const atcBtn = popup.querySelector('.creator-reels__popup-atc-btn');
      const popupTitle = popup.querySelector('.creator-reels__popup-title');
      const atcToast = popup.querySelector('.creator-reels__popup-atc-toast');
      const variantStrip = popup.querySelector('.creator-reels__popup-variant-strip');
      let atcToastTimer = null;
      let videosLoaded = false;

      if (!popup || !videoWrappers.length) return;

      // Lazy-load carousel video sources once (~200px before viewport).
      // Posters use <img loading="lazy"> — no JS poster loading.
      function loadCarouselVideos() {
        if (videosLoaded) return;
        videosLoaded = true;
        carouselVideos.forEach((video) => {
          if (video.getAttribute('src')) return;
          const container = video.closest('.creator-reels__video-container');
          const url = container && container.dataset.videoUrl;
          if (!url) return;
          video.preload = 'metadata';
          video.src = url;
        });
      }

      function ensureReelLipstickSelection() {
        if (!variantStrip) return;
        const picker = variantStrip.querySelector('.reel-variant-picker--lipstick');
        if (!picker) return;
        let selected = picker.querySelector('.reel-v-wrap--lipstick.is-selected');
        if (!selected) {
          selected = picker.querySelector('.reel-v-wrap--lipstick:not(.reel-v-wrap--oos)');
          if (selected) {
            selected.classList.add('is-selected');
            const innerBtn = selected.querySelector('button.reel-v-btn');
            if (innerBtn) innerBtn.classList.add('is-selected');
          }
        }
        picker.querySelectorAll('.reel-v-wrap--lipstick').forEach((wrap) => {
          const swatch = wrap.querySelector('.reel-lip-swatch');
          if (swatch) swatch.classList.toggle('is-selected', wrap.classList.contains('is-selected'));
        });
        const active = picker.querySelector('.reel-v-wrap--lipstick.is-selected');
        if (active && typeof window.scrollSelectedReelVariantIntoView === 'function') {
          requestAnimationFrame(function () {
            window.scrollSelectedReelVariantIntoView(variantStrip);
          });
        }
      }

      function syncReelPopupAtcFromVariant() {
        if (!atcBtn || !variantStrip) return;
        const stripRoot = variantStrip.querySelector('.reel-variant-picker');
        if (!stripRoot) return;
        const selected = stripRoot.querySelector('.reel-v-wrap.is-selected button.reel-v-btn');
        const btn = selected || stripRoot.querySelector('button.reel-v-btn');
        if (!btn) return;
        const vid = btn.getAttribute('data-variant-id');
        const price = btn.getAttribute('data-variant-price');
        const selectedProductTitle = btn.getAttribute('data-product-title');
        if (vid) atcBtn.setAttribute('data-selected-variant-id', vid);
        if (price) {
          const priceEl = atcBtn.querySelector('.creator-reels__popup-atc-price');
          if (priceEl) priceEl.textContent = price;
        }
        if (popupTitle) {
          popupTitle.textContent =
            (selectedProductTitle && selectedProductTitle.trim()) ||
            popupTitle.getAttribute('data-default-title') ||
            popupTitle.textContent;
        }
      }

      function syncMobileCartToolbarUI(itemCount) {
        if (typeof window.syncMobileCartToolbarUI === 'function') {
          window.syncMobileCartToolbarUI(itemCount);
          return;
        }
        const count = itemCount != null ? itemCount : 0;
        const hasItems = count > 0;
        document.querySelectorAll('.hdt-section-toolbar-mobile-cart').forEach((cartEl) => {
          cartEl.classList.remove('hdt-cart-count-many', 'hdt-cart-count-one');
          const activeIcon = cartEl.querySelector('.cart-active-state-icon');
          const normalIcon = cartEl.querySelector('.cart-normal-state-icon');
          const countEl = cartEl.querySelector('hdt-cart-count');
          if (activeIcon) {
            activeIcon.classList.toggle('show-active-icon', hasItems);
            activeIcon.classList.toggle('hide-active-icon', !hasItems);
          }
          if (normalIcon) {
            normalIcon.classList.toggle('hide-active-icon', hasItems);
            normalIcon.classList.toggle('show-active-icon', !hasItems);
          }
          if (countEl) {
            countEl.classList.toggle('hide-cart-counter', !hasItems);
          }
        });
      }

      document.addEventListener('cart:change', (e) => {
        const itemCount = e?.detail?.cart?.item_count;
        if (itemCount != null) syncMobileCartToolbarUI(itemCount);
      });
      document.addEventListener('cart:refresh', () => {
        fetch('/cart.js')
          .then((r) => r.json())

        (function () {
          var section = document.currentScript && document.currentScript.previousElementSibling;
          if (!section || !section.classList.contains('product-results-wrapper')) {
            section = document.querySelector('.product-results-wrapper');
          }
          if (!section) return;

          if (!images.length) return;

          function loadFullImage(img) {
            var fullSrc = img.getAttribute('data-src');
            if (!fullSrc || img.dataset.prLoaded === '1') return;
            img.dataset.prLoaded = '1';
            img.removeAttribute('data-src');

            function reveal() {
              var wrap = img.closest('.product-results__image');
              if (wrap) wrap.classList.add('is-loaded');
            }

            img.onload = reveal;
            img.onerror = reveal;
            img.src = fullSrc;
            if (img.complete && img.naturalWidth > 1) reveal();
          }

          function loadVisible() {
            images.forEach(function (img) {
              var wrap = img.closest('.product-results__image');
              if (wrap && wrap.offsetParent !== null) loadFullImage(img);
            });
          }

          if (!('IntersectionObserver' in window)) {
            loadVisible();
            return;
          }

          var observer = new IntersectionObserver(
            function (entries) {
              entries.forEach(function (entry) {
                if (!entry.isIntersecting) return;
                loadVisible();
                observer.disconnect();
              });

          observer.observe(section);

                  <strong>How should I apply Mamaearth Vitamin C Daily Glow Face Serum for the best results?</strong>
                  <p>For the best results, you should apply Mamaearth Vitamin C Daily Glow Face Serum on a clean and dry face. Use 2-3 drops and gently massage them in upward circular motions (after cleansing and toning, and before moisturizing). Apply it in the morning and follow up with good broad-spectrum sunscreen to protect your skin. This routine ensures maximum glow and protection.</p>
                </div>
              
            
              
                <div class="product-faqs-item">
                  <strong>What are the key benefits of using Mamaearth Vitamin C Daily Glow Face Serum daily?</strong>
                  <p>Using Mamaearth Vitamin C Daily Glow Face Serum daily helps boost natural radiance, fade dark spots, reduce dullness, and improve overall skin tone. Packed with Vitamin C and Turmeric, it also supports collagen production, combats free radical damage, and promotes glowing, even-toned skin with regular use.</p>
                </div>
              
            
              
                <div class="product-faqs-item">
                  <strong>Is Mamaearth Vitamin C Daily Glow Face Serum suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin?</strong>
                  <p>Yes, Mamaearth Vitamin C Daily Glow Face Serum is dermatologically tested to be safe for all skin types, including sensitive skin. It's made with safe and toxin-free ingredients that make it gentle yet effective. However, if you have extremely reactive skin, a patch test is recommended before full application.</p>
                </div>
              
            
              
                <div class="product-faqs-item">
                  <strong>Can teenagers safely use Mamaearth Vitamin C Daily Glow Face Serum?</strong>
                  <p>Yes, teenagers over 18 years can safely use Mamaearth Vitamin C Daily Glow Face Serum, especially if they’re dealing with dullness, uneven skin tone, or acne marks. It’s gentle on young skin and helps maintain a natural glow without irritation.</p>
                </div>
              
            
              
                <div class="product-faqs-item">
                  <strong>What are the main ingredients in Mamaearth Vitamin C Daily Glow Face Serum and how do they help the skin?</strong>
                  <p>The key ingredients in Mamaearth Vitamin C Daily Glow Face Serum include:Vitamin C: Brightens the skin, fades dark spots, and promotes collagen synthesis.Turmeric: Known for its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, it boosts glow and soothes the skin.Niacinamide: Helps reduce blemishes and improve skin texture.Together, these ingredients work to give your skin a healthy, radiant glow naturally.</p>
                </div>
              
            
              
                <div class="product-faqs-item">
                  <strong>What is the difference between Ethyl Ascorbic Acid and L-Ascorbic Acid in terms of stability and skin absorption?</strong>
                  <p>Ethyl Ascorbic Acid is a more stable and water-soluble derivative of Vitamin C compared to L-Ascorbic Acid. It resists oxidation, penetrates the skin effectively, and delivers lasting brightness. L-Ascorbic Acid tends to oxidize quickly, reducing its potency and absorption over time.</p>
                </div>
              
            
              
                <div class="product-faqs-item">
                  <strong>Why is Ethyl Ascorbic Acid considered a more stable form of Vitamin C in skincare serums?</strong>
                  <p>Ethyl Ascorbic Acid remains stable even when exposed to light and air, making it ideal for skincare serums like Mamaearth’s Vitamin C Daily Glow Face Serum. Its stability ensures consistent antioxidant activity and deeper skin absorption for a visible glow and even skin tone.</p>
                </div>

                  <strong>Which serum is best for clear and glowing skin in India?</strong>
                  <p>If you're searching for the best serum for clear and glowing skin in India, Mamaearth Vitamin C Daily Glow Face Serum stands out. It’s enriched with natural ingredients, free from toxins, suitable for Indian skin types, and delivers a visible glow and even tone with consistent use. Highly rated for its effectiveness and affordability!</p>
                </div>
              
            
              
                <div class="product-faqs-item">
                  <strong>How often should I use Mamaearth Vitamin C Daily Glow Face Serum – morning or night?</strong>
                  <p>For optimal results, use Mamaearth Vitamin C Daily Glow Face Serum twice a day – morning and night. In the morning, pair it with sunscreen. At night, apply it with a moisturizer. This twice-daily routine helps maintain a consistent glow and protects your skin from daily damage.</p>
                </div>
              
            
              
                <div class="product-faqs-item">
                  <strong>Does Mamaearth Vitamin C Daily Glow Face Serum help reduce dullness and promote radiant, glowing skin?</strong>
                  <p>Yes, this serum is specially designed to combat dullness and promote a healthy, radiant glow. With the power of Vitamin C and Turmeric, it revitalizes tired-looking skin, enhances skin clarity, and restores your natural brightness, making it a go-to for glowing skin lovers.</p>
                </div>
              
            
              
                <div class="product-faqs-item">
                  <strong>Will Mamaearth Vitamin C Daily Glow Face Serum work on dark spots and uneven skin tone?</strong>
                  <p>Yes, regular use of Mamaearth Vitamin C Daily Glow Face Serum helps fade dark spots and correct uneven skin tone. The presence of Vitamin C accelerates skin cell turnover and lightens pigmentation, while Niacinamide supports a more balanced, clear complexion.</p>
                </div>
              
            
              
                <div class="product-faqs-item">
                  <strong>Can I use Mamaearth Vitamin C Daily Glow Face Serum along with sunscreen or moisturizer?</strong>
                  <p>Yes. Apply the Vitamin C serum first, allow it to absorb for a minute or two, then follow up with your moisturizer. In the daytime, always finish your routine with a broad-spectrum sunscreen to lock in the benefits and protect your skin from UV damage.</p>

  (function () {
    function setSubAccordionHeight(menu) {
      var content = menu.querySelector('.hdt-collapse-content');
      if (!content || window.innerWidth >= 768) return;
      content.style.height = menu.classList.contains('open') ? 'auto' : '0';
    }

    function bindSubAccordions(root) {
      root.querySelectorAll('.hdt-footer-menu .hdt-footer-sub-accordion__header').forEach(function (header) {
        if (header.dataset.footerSubAccordionBound === 'true') return;
        header.dataset.footerSubAccordionBound = 'true';
        header.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
          if (window.innerWidth >= 768) return;
          event.stopPropagation();
          var menu = this.closest('.hdt-footer-menu');
          if (!menu) return;
          menu.classList.toggle('open');
          setSubAccordionHeight(menu);
        });
      });
    }

    function initSubAccordions(root) {
      root.querySelectorAll('.hdt-footer-menu').forEach(function (menu) {
        if (menu.querySelector('.hdt-footer-first-menu-links')) return;
        setSubAccordionHeight(menu);
      });
    }

    function resetSubAccordions(accordion) {
      if (!accordion || window.innerWidth >= 768) return;
      accordion.querySelectorAll('.hdt-footer-menu').forEach(function (menu) {
        if (menu.querySelector('.hdt-footer-first-menu-links')) return;
        menu.classList.remove('open');
        setSubAccordionHeight(menu);
      });
    }

    function closeMobileFooterAccordion(accordion) {
      if (!accordion) return;
      resetSubAccordions(accordion);
      accordion.classList.remove('is-open');
      var trigger = accordion.querySelector('.hdt-footer-mobile-accordion__trigger');
      if (trigger) trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    }

    function bindMobileFooterAccordion() {
      document.querySelectorAll('.hdt-footer-mobile-accordion').forEach(function (accordion) {
        var trigger = accordion.querySelector('.hdt-footer-mobile-accordion__trigger');
        var closeBtn = accordion.querySelector('.hdt-footer-mobile-accordion__panel-heading');

        if (trigger && trigger.dataset.footerMainAccordionBound !== 'true') {
          trigger.dataset.footerMainAccordionBound = 'true';
          trigger.addEventListener('click', function () {
            if (window.innerWidth >= 768) return;
            resetSubAccordions(accordion);
            accordion.classList.add('is-open');
            this.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
            initSubAccordions(accordion);
            bindSubAccordions(accordion);
          });

          closeBtn.dataset.footerMainAccordionBound = 'true';

          });

      });

      bindSubAccordions(document);
      if (window.innerWidth < 768) {

  </svg><script>
  (() => {
    if (window.__hdtPriceSummarySheetInit) return;
    window.__hdtPriceSummarySheetInit = true;

    const SHEET_ID = 'cart-drawer-price-summary-sheet';
    const OVERLAY_ID = 'cart-drawer-price-summary-overlay';
    const OPEN_CLASS = 'is-open';

    function getSheet() {
      return document.getElementById(SHEET_ID);
    }

    function getOverlay() {
      return document.getElementById(OVERLAY_ID);
    }

    function getCartDrawer() {
      return document.getElementById('CartDrawer');
    }

    function patchCartDrawerOutsideClick() {
      const drawer = getCartDrawer();
      if (!drawer || drawer.__priceSummaryPatched) return;
      drawer.__priceSummaryPatched = true;
      const originalHide = drawer.hideForOutsideClickTarget
        ? drawer.hideForOutsideClickTarget.bind(drawer)
        : function (target) {
            return !drawer.contains(target);
          };
      drawer.hideForOutsideClickTarget = function (target) {
        const sheet = getSheet();
        const overlay = getOverlay();
        if (sheet && !sheet.hidden && target && sheet.contains(target)) return false;
        if (overlay && !overlay.hidden && target === overlay) return false;
        return originalHide(target);
      };
      drawer.allowOutsideClickForTarget = function (target) {
        const sheet = getSheet();
        const overlay = getOverlay();
        if (sheet && !sheet.hidden && target && sheet.contains(target)) return true;
        if (overlay && !overlay.hidden && target === overlay) return true;
        return false;
      };
    }

    function ensureSheetLayer() {
      // If multiple sheets exist (e.g. cart re-render duplicated the template), prefer the body-level one.
      const allSheets = document.querySelectorAll('#' + SHEET_ID);
      if (allSheets.length > 1) {
        let canonical = null;
        allSheets.forEach((node) => {
          if (!canonical && node.parentNode === document.body) canonical = node;
        });
        allSheets.forEach((node) => {
          if (node !== canonical) node.remove();
        });
      }
      const sheet = getSheet();
      if (!sheet) return null;
      if (sheet.parentNode !== document.body) {
        document.body.appendChild(sheet);
      }
      if (!sheet.dataset.handlersBound) {
        sheet.dataset.handlersBound = 'true';
        sheet.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
          event.stopPropagation();
          const closeTrigger = event.target.closest('[data-close-price-summary-sheet]');
          if (closeTrigger) {
            event.preventDefault();
            closeSheet();
          }
        });
        ['pointerdown', 'mousedown', 'touchstart'].forEach((evt) => {
          sheet.addEventListener(evt, (e) => e.stopPropagation(), { passive: true });
        });
      }
      return sheet;
    }

    function ensureOverlayLayer() {
      let overlay = getOverlay();
      if (!overlay) {
        overlay = document.createElement('div');
        overlay.id = OVERLAY_ID;
        overlay.className = 'hdt-price-summary-overlay';
        overlay.hidden = true;
        overlay.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
          event.stopPropagation();
          closeSheet();
        });
        ['pointerdown', 'mousedown', 'touchstart'].forEach((evt) => {
          overlay.addEventListener(evt, (e) => e.stopPropagation(), { passive: true });
        });
        document.body.appendChild(overlay);
      } else if (overlay.parentNode !== document.body) {
        document.body.appendChild(overlay);
      }
      return overlay;
    }

    function syncSummaryCard() {
      const sheet = getSheet();
      if (!sheet) return;
      const source = document.getElementById('cart-drawer-price-summary');
      const body = sheet.querySelector('[data-price-summary-sheet-body]');
      if (!source || !body) return;
      const clone = source.cloneNode(true);
      clone.removeAttribute('id');
      clone.classList.add('hdt-price-summary-sheet__summary');
      body.replaceChildren(clone);
    }

    function setSheetBottomInset() {
      const sheet = getSheet();
      if (!sheet) return;
      const checkoutBar = document.querySelector('#CartDrawer .hdt-mini-cart__checkout-bar');
      if (!checkoutBar) {
        sheet.style.removeProperty('--hdt-price-summary-bottom-offset');
        return;
      }
      const rect = checkoutBar.getBoundingClientRect();
      const viewportH = window.innerHeight || document.documentElement.clientHeight;
      const gap = 8;
      const bottomInset = Math.max(0, Math.round(viewportH - rect.top + gap));
      sheet.style.setProperty('--hdt-price-summary-bottom-offset', bottomInset + 'px');
    }

    function openSheet() {
      patchCartDrawerOutsideClick();
      const sheet = ensureSheetLayer();
      if (!sheet) return;
      const overlay = ensureOverlayLayer();
      setSheetBottomInset();
      syncOverlayInset(sheet, overlay);
      syncSummaryCard();
      sheet.hidden = false;
      overlay.hidden = false;
      sheet.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        sheet.classList.add(OPEN_CLASS);
        overlay.classList.add(OPEN_CLASS);
      });
    }

    function closeSheet() {
      const sheet = getSheet();
      const overlay = getOverlay();
      if (sheet && !sheet.hidden) {
        sheet.classList.remove(OPEN_CLASS);
        sheet.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
        window.setTimeout(() => {
          if (sheet.classList.contains(OPEN_CLASS)) return;
          sheet.hidden = true;
        }, 260);
      }
      if (overlay && !overlay.hidden) {
        overlay.classList.remove(OPEN_CLASS);
        window.setTimeout(() => {
          if (overlay.classList.contains(OPEN_CLASS)) return;
          overlay.hidden = true;
        }, 260);
      }
    }

    function syncOverlayInset(sheet, overlay) {
      const offset = sheet.style.getPropertyValue('--hdt-price-summary-bottom-offset') || '84px';
      overlay.style.setProperty('--hdt-price-summary-bottom-offset', offset);
    }

    function isDesktopViewport() {
      return window.matchMedia('(min-width: 768px)').matches;
    }

    document.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
      const openButton = event.target.closest('[data-open-price-summary-sheet]');
      if (openButton) {
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();
        if (isDesktopViewport()) return;
        openSheet();
        return;
      }
    });

    document.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
      const sheet = getSheet();
      if (event.key === 'Escape' && sheet && !sheet.hidden) {
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();
        closeSheet();
      }
    });

    document.addEventListener('cart:drawer:render', closeSheet);
    document.addEventListener('cart:change', () => {
      const sheet = getSheet();
      if (sheet && !sheet.hidden) syncSummaryCard();
    });
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
      if (isDesktopViewport()) {
        closeSheet();
        return;
      }
      const sheet = getSheet();
      if (sheet && !sheet.hidden) {
        setSheetBottomInset();
        const overlay = getOverlay();
        if (overlay) syncOverlayInset(sheet, overlay);
      }
    });
  })();
</script>

<script>
    (() => {
      if (window.__hdtCapiCaptureInit) return;
      window.__hdtCapiCaptureInit = true;
  
      const getCookieValue = (name) =>
        document.cookie
          .split('; ')
          .find((row) => row.startsWith(`${name}=`))
          ?.split('=')[1] || null;
  
      const captureCapiData = async (cart) => {
        try {
          const fbp = getCookieValue('_fbp');
          const fbc = getCookieValue('_fbc');
  
          let cartId = cart?.token;
  
          if (!cartId) {
            const cartResponse = await fetch('/cart.js');
            const cartData = await cartResponse.json();
            cartId = cartData?.token;
          }
  
          if (!cartId) return;
  
          const controller = new AbortController();
          const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 4000);
  
          fetch('https://api-v1.mamaearth.in/v1/external/capture-capi-data', {
            method: 'POST',
            keepalive: true,
            signal: controller.signal,
            headers: {
              'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({
              cartId,
              fbc,
              fbp,
            }),
          })
            .then((response) => {
              clearTimeout(timeoutId);
              if (!response.ok) {
                console.error('CAPI capture failed:', response.status, response.statusText);
              }
            })
            .catch((err) => {
              clearTimeout(timeoutId);
              console.error('CAPI capture failed:', err);
            });
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Error capturing CAPI data:', error);
        }
      };
  
      document.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        if (!event.target.closest('#proceed_to_checkout_btn')) return;
  
        const cartVariableElement = document.getElementById('cartvariable');
        const cartText = cartVariableElement?.textContent;
  
        if (!cartText) {
          captureCapiData(null);
          return;
        }
  
        try {
          captureCapiData(JSON.parse(cartText));
        } catch (e) {
          captureCapiData(null);
          console.error('Failed to parse cart JSON:', e);
        }
      });
    })();
  </script>

<script>
(function() {
  // Prevent multiple initializations
  if (window.deviceIdUtilityLoaded) {
    return;
  }
  window.deviceIdUtilityLoaded = true;

  /**
   * Generates a unique device ID in UUID v4 format
   * Format: xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx
   * @returns {string} A unique UUID v4 string
   */
  function generateDeviceId() {
    return 'xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx'.replace(/[xy]/g, function(c) {
      const r = Math.random() * 16 | 0;
      const v = c === 'x' ? r : (r & 0x3 | 0x8);
      return v.toString(16);
    });
  }

  /**
   * Gets or creates a device ID from localStorage
   * This ID persists across sessions and is independent of user login status
   * @returns {string} The device ID
   */
  function getDeviceId() {
    const STORAGE_KEY = 'shp_device_id';
    let deviceId = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    
    // If device ID doesn't exist, generate and store it
    if (!deviceId) {
      deviceId = generateDeviceId();
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, deviceId);
        console.log('[Device ID] Generated new device ID:', deviceId);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('[Device ID] Failed to store device ID in localStorage:', error);
      }
    }
    
    return deviceId;
  }

  /**
   * Resets the device ID (useful for testing or debugging)
   * Generates a new device ID and stores it
   * @returns {string} The new device ID
   */
  function resetDeviceId() {
    const STORAGE_KEY = 'shp_device_id';
    const newDeviceId = generateDeviceId();
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, newDeviceId);
      console.log('[Device ID] Reset device ID to:', newDeviceId);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[Device ID] Failed to reset device ID:', error);
    }
    return newDeviceId;
  }

  // Expose functions globally
  window.getDeviceId = getDeviceId;
  window.generateDeviceId = generateDeviceId;
  window.resetDeviceId = resetDeviceId;

  // Initialize device ID on load to ensure it exists
  getDeviceId();
})();

        if (!ids.length) return null;
        if (ids.length === 1) return ids[0];
        return ids.join(',');
      }
      return resolveFbqContentId(value);
    }

    function fbqContentIdFromLineItem(item) {
      if (!item) return null;
      var oldId = resolveOldProductId(item.product_id, item);
      return resolveFbqContentId(oldId || item.product_id);
    }

    function fbqContentIdsFromLineItems(items) {
      if (!items || !items.length) return null;
      var ids = items.map(fbqContentIdFromLineItem).filter(function (id) {
        return id != null && id !== '';
      });
      return formatFbqContentIds(ids);
    }

    function fbqProductId(oldProductId, productId) {
      return resolveFbqContentId(oldProductId || productId);
    }

    function fireFbq(eventName, params, eventOptions) {
      if (typeof fbq !== 'function') return;
      if (window.__meFbqConsent) window.__meFbqConsent();

      var payload = params ? Object.assign({}, params) : {};
      if (payload.content_ids !== undefined) {
        payload.content_ids = formatFbqContentIds(payload.content_ids);
        if (payload.content_ids == null || payload.content_ids === '') return;
      }

      if (eventOptions) {
        fbq('track', eventName, payload, eventOptions);
      } else {
        fbq('track', eventName, payload);
      }
    }

    function normalizeContentIds(sku, variantId, productId) {
      var id = sku || (variantId ? String(variantId) : productId ? String(productId) : '');
      return id ? resolveFbqContentId(id) : null;
    }

    function fireFbqAddToCart(params) {
      if (typeof fbq !== 'function') return;
      if (window.__meFbqConsent) window.__meFbqConsent();

      var contentId = formatFbqContentIds(params.content_ids);
      if (contentId == null || contentId === '') return;

      var dedupeKey = String(contentId) + '|' + (params.value || 0);
      var now = Date.now();
      if (dedupeKey === lastFbqAddToCartKey && now - lastFbqAddToCartAt < 2500) return;
      lastFbqAddToCartKey = dedupeKey;
      lastFbqAddToCartAt = now;

      fireFbq('AddToCart', {
        content_ids: contentId,
        content_type: 'product',
        value: Number(params.value) || 0,
        currency: params.currency || 'INR',
        content_name: params.content_name,

      });
    }

      window.addEventListener('message', function (e) {
        
        // OPTIONAL: lock down origin in production
        // if (e.origin !== window.location.origin) return;

        // Handle sticky cart click (from shadow DOM)
        if (e.data && e.data.name === 'sticky_cart_clicked_sc') {
          fireViewCart('sticky_cart');
        }

        if (
            e.data &&
            e.data.type === 'snowplow_event' &&
            e.data.context &&
            e.data.context.action === "logged_in" &&
            e.data.context.value
          ) {
            const phoneNumber = "+91" + e.data.context.value;
            Moengage.identifyUser(phoneNumber);
          }

          if (
            e.data &&
            e.data.type === 'snowplow_event' &&
            e.data.context &&
            e.data.context.action === "logged_in" &&
            e.data.context.value
          ) {
            const phoneNumber = "+91" + e.data.context.value;
            Moengage.identifyUser(phoneNumber);
          }


        // Handle view cart clicked (typically from cart drawer/widget when cart icon is clicked)
        if (e.data && e.data.name === 'view_cart_clicked') {
          // Use header_cart as default, or check if we can determine the source from the message body
          var clickFrom = (e.data.body && e.data.body.click_from) || 'cart_icon';
          fireViewCart(clickFrom);
        }

        // Handle checkout button clicked
        if (e.data && e.data.name === 'checkout_button_clicked_sc') {
          var checkoutType = (e.data.body && e.data.body.checkout_type) || 'checkout_1.0';
          fireBeginCheckout(checkoutType);
        }

        window.fireCouponEvent = function (eventName, status, isApplied, e, toPayAmount) {
          withFreshCart(function (cart) {
            var items = cart.items.map(mapCartLineItem);
            var itemBundle = items.slice();
            var orderTotal = calcOrderTotal(cart);
            var grandTotal = calcGrandTotal(cart, toPayAmount);
            var couponName = (e && e.data && e.data.body && e.data.body.title) || getCouponName(cart);

            var payload = {
              event: eventName,
              cartId: cart.token,
              cart_value_order_total: orderTotal,
              cart_value_grand_total: grandTotal,
              cart_items: items,
              couponName: couponName,
              couponStatus: status,
              isCouponApplied: isApplied,
              item_bundle: itemBundle,
              ecommerce: {
                currency: 'INR',
                value: grandTotal,
                coupon: couponName,
                items: items
              },
              page: page_name,
              url: pageURL,
              isLoggedIn: localStorage.getItem('isLoggedIn') === 'true'
            };

            pushDL(payload);

            var moPayload = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(payload));
            delete moPayload.event;
            trackME(eventName, moPayload);

            if (isApplied && couponName) {
              trackME('applyCoupon', { couponName: couponName });
            }
          });
        };

        if (e.data?.name === 'coupon_code_applied_sc') {
          fireCouponEvent('couponApplied', 'applied', true, e);
        }

        if (e.data?.name === 'remove_applied_offer_sc') {
          // Reset stored to_pay_amount when coupon is removed so future view_cart events use cart.js data
          window.updatedCartToPayAmount = null;
          // Refresh cart data to get the original cart.js response without discount
          getcartitem(null, { forceRefresh: true });
          console.log('Coupon removed: Reset updatedCartToPayAmount to null, cart will now use original cart.js response');
          // Fire events (these will calculate from fresh cart data, not stored discount amount)
          fireCouponEvent('couponRemoved', 'removed', false, e);
          fireCouponEvent('analytics_coupon_removed', 'removed', false, e);
        }

        /* ===============================
           DISCOUNT APPLICATION
        =============================== */
        if (e.data?.name === 'discount_application' && e.data?.body) {
          var discountData = e.data.body;
          var toPayAmount = discountData.to_pay_amount;
          var discount = discountData.discount || 0;
          var cartTotal = discountData.cart_total || 0;
          var cartCount = discountData.cart_count || 0;

          // Auto-detect if values are in cents (very large numbers) or rupees
          // If toPayAmount > 10000, assume it's in cents (e.g., 87840 cents = 878.4 rupees)
          // Otherwise assume it's already in rupees
          var divisor = (toPayAmount && toPayAmount > 10000) ? 100 : 1;

          // Store updated to_pay_amount globally so it can be used in fireViewCart and other functions
          if (toPayAmount !== undefined && toPayAmount !== null) {
            var toPayAmountInRupees = toPayAmount / divisor;
            window.updatedCartToPayAmount = toPayAmountInRupees;

            console.log('Discount application: to_pay_amount stored as', toPayAmountInRupees, '(original:', toPayAmount, ', divisor:', divisor + ')');

            // Fire event with updated to_pay_amount
            fireCouponEvent('discountApplied', 'applied', true, e, toPayAmountInRupees);
          }

          // Also push a generic discount_application event with all the data
          window.dataLayer.push({
            event: 'discount_application',
            discount: discount / divisor,
            cart_total: cartTotal / divisor,
            cart_count: cartCount,
            to_pay_amount: toPayAmount / divisor,
            url: pageURL,
            page: page_name
          });

          trackME('discount_application', {
            discount: discount / divisor,
            cart_total: cartTotal / divisor,
            cart_count: cartCount,
            to_pay_amount: toPayAmount / divisor,
            url: pageURL,
            page: page_name
          });
        }

        

        /* ===============================
           PAYMENT SCREEN LOAD
           Fires when paymentStep event is received from shopifyAnalytics
        =============================== */

        if (e.data?.analyticsName === 'shopifyAnalytics' && e.data?.eventName === 'paymentStep') {
          var paymentData = e.data?.data || {};
          var commonData = paymentData?.commonAnalyticsData || {};
          var products = commonData?.products || [];

          // Map products to items format
          var items = products.map(function (product) {
            return {
              item_id: product['Product SKU'] || product['Product ID'],
              product_id: product['Product ID'],
              item_name: product['Product Name'],
              price: product['Product Price'] || 0,
              quantity: product['Product Quantity'] || 1,
              currency: product['Currency'] || 'INR'
            };
          });

          var payload = {
            event: 'payment_screen_load',
            environmentType: 'shopify',
            platform: 'website',
            currency: commonData?.currency || 'INR',
            cart_total_price: commonData?.cart_total_price || 0,
            cart_after_discount: commonData?.cart_after_discount || 0,
            total_quantity: commonData?.total_quantity || 0,
            coupon: commonData?.coupon || '',
            auto_coupon: commonData?.auto_coupon || '',
            discount_amount: paymentData?.discountAmount || 0,
            ecommerce: {
              currency: commonData?.currency || 'INR',
              value: commonData?.cart_after_discount || commonData?.cart_total_price || 0,
              coupon: commonData?.coupon || '',
              items: items
            },
            url: pageURL,
            page: page_name,
            timestamp: paymentData?.timestamp || Date.now(),
            mobileApp: paymentData?.mobileApp || false
          };

          window.dataLayer.push(payload);

          // MoEngage
          var moPayload = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(payload));
          delete moPayload.event;

  /**
   * Identifies account-related URLs that must be gated until KwikPass scripts load.
   */
  function isAccountPath(pathname) {
    if (!pathname) return false;
    return (
      pathname === '/account' ||
      pathname.startsWith('/account/login') ||
      pathname.startsWith('/account/register') ||
      pathname.endsWith('/account') ||
      pathname.indexOf('customer_authentication') !== -1 ||
      pathname === '/account/addresses'
    );
  }

  /**
   * KwikpassAccountGate
   * -------------------
   * Blocks navigation to account pages (see isAccountPath) until every required
   * KwikPass script has loaded successfully.
   *
   * Design notes:
   * - A SINGLE delegated click listener is attached on `document` in the CAPTURE
   *   phase. This means it runs before any bubbling / inline `onclick` handlers,
   *   so navigation is reliably blocked even for links clicked before scripts
   *   finish loading (the race condition we care about). No per-anchor listeners.
   * - A MutationObserver only manages the visual `kwikpass-loading` class on
   *   dynamically injected account links; the actual click-blocking never depends
   *   on the observer, so newly added links are protected immediately by delegation.
   * - Loading state is centralized: every registered script key must flip to true
   *   before the gate lifts. If ANY script fails, the gate stays locked.
   */
  var KwikpassAccountGate = (function () {
    var LOADING_CLASS = 'kwikpass-loading';
    var STYLE_ID = 'kwikpass-gate-style';

    var scriptStatus = Object.create(null); // key -> true once that script loads
    var requiredScripts = [];
    var failed = false;        // a required script errored -> stay locked
    var unlocked = false;      // gate lifted; navigation allowed
    var observer = null;
    var clickListenerAttached = false;

    // Resolve an anchor's pathname tolerantly (handles relative/absolute hrefs).
    function getAnchorPath(anchor) {
      try {
        return anchor.pathname || new URL(anchor.href, window.location.origin).pathname;
      } catch (e) {
        return null;
      }
    }

    function isAccountAnchor(anchor) {
      if (!anchor || anchor.tagName !== 'A') return false;
      var href = anchor.getAttribute('href');
      // Ignore non-navigational hrefs (in-page anchors, javascript: handlers).
      if (!href || href.indexOf('javascript:') === 0 || href.charAt(0) === '#') return false;
      return isAccountPath(getAnchorPath(anchor));
    }

    // Single delegated capture-phase handler: blocks account-link navigation
    // while the gate is locked.
    function onDocumentClick(event) {
      if (unlocked) return;
      var target = event.target;
      var anchor = target && target.closest ? target.closest('a[href]') : null;
      if (!anchor || !isAccountAnchor(anchor)) return;
      event.preventDefault();

  function runWhenIdle(fn, timeout){
    if(typeof requestIdleCallback === 'function'){
      requestIdleCallback(fn, { timeout: timeout });
    }else{
      setTimeout(fn, 0);
    }
  }

  function isJifyScriptAlreadyPresent(){
    return !!document.querySelector('script[src*="/jify/"]');
  }

  function loadLowPriorityScript(src){
    runWhenIdle(function(){
      try{
        if(isJifyScriptAlreadyPresent()){
          return;
        }
        var script = document.createElement('script');
        script.src = src;
        script.type = 'module';
        script.async = true;
        script.setAttribute('fetchpriority', 'low');
        document.body.appendChild(script);
      }catch(err){
        console.error(err);
      }
    }, 5000);
  }

  function checkMerchantStatusAndLoadLowPriorityScript(merchantId){

        var kpRequestId = generateKpRequestId();
        var merchantStatusUrl = 'https://gkx.gokwik.co/jify/api/v1/merchant/status';

        fetch(merchantStatusUrl, {
          method: 'GET',
          priority: 'low',
          headers: {
            'gk-merchant-id': merchantId,
            'kp-merchant-id': merchantId,
            'kp-request-id': kpRequestId,

        .then(function(response){ return response.json(); })
        .then(function(data){
          if(data && data.enabled === true && KP_LOW_PRIORITY_SCRIPT_URL){

// lightning sale timer 
function initLightningSaleTimers() {
  document.querySelectorAll(".st-product-card").forEach(function (card) {
    if (card.querySelector(".lightingsaletag_labels")) return;

    const fieldBox = card.querySelector(".st-extra-field-box.st_sale_end_time .st-extra-field-value");
    if (!fieldBox) return;

    const saleEndRaw = fieldBox.textContent.trim();
    if (!saleEndRaw) return;

    const saleEndTime = new Date(saleEndRaw).getTime();
    const now = Date.now();

    if (!saleEndTime || saleEndTime <= now) return;

    const imageBox =
      card.querySelector(".st-image-container") ||
      card.querySelector(".st-image-wrapper") ||
      card.querySelector(".st-outer-box");

    if (!imageBox) return;

    const timerHTML = `
      <div class="m_prod_label st-lightning-sale-wrapper">
        <div class="m_prod_labels lightening-sale">
          <div class="lightingsaletag_labels">
            <div
              class="tag lightingsale"
              data-sale-timestamp="${saleEndTime}"
              data-timer-format="colon"
            >
              <img 
                src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0721/7558/3279/files/card_lighting_sale.gif"
                width="100%"
                height="auto"
                alt="lighting sale flash"
                class="lighting_sale_flash"
              >
              <span class="lightingsaletimer"></span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;

    imageBox.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", timerHTML);
  });

  startLightningSaleCountdown();
}

function startLightningSaleCountdown() {
  document.querySelectorAll(".tag.lightingsale").forEach(function (timerBox) {
    if (timerBox.dataset.timerInitialized === "true") return;

    timerBox.dataset.timerInitialized = "true";

    const endTime = Number(timerBox.dataset.saleTimestamp);
    const timerText = timerBox.querySelector(".lightingsaletimer");

    function updateTimer() {
      const diff = endTime - Date.now();

      if (diff <= 0) {
        const wrapper = timerBox.closest(".m_prod_label");
        if (wrapper) wrapper.remove();
        return;
      }

      const totalSeconds = Math.floor(diff / 1000);
      const hours = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 3600);
      const minutes = Math.floor((totalSeconds % 3600) / 60);
      const seconds = totalSeconds % 60;

      timerText.textContent = `${hours}h:${minutes}m:${seconds}s`;
    }

    updateTimer();
    setInterval(updateTimer, 1000);
  });
}

document.addEventListener("stSearchResultsEvent", function () {
  setTimeout(initLightningSaleTimers, 300);
});

// dynamic placeholder 
window.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    let searchInputBoxSelector = document.querySelectorAll(".st-search-box.hidden-mobile input[name='st'],  .st-search-box.hidden-desktop.st-hidden-desktop input[name='st']");

    searchInputBoxSelector.forEach((searchInputBox) => {
        if (searchInputBox) {
            searchInputBox.setAttribute("placeholder", "");
            const placeHolderPhrases = [
                "Search For Soap",
                "Search For Serum",
                "Search For Face Wash"
            ];

            let index = 0;
            let typingTimer;
            const updatePlaceHolder = function () {
                const phrase = placeHolderPhrases[index];
                const length = phrase.length;
                let queryIndex = 0;
                typingTimer = setInterval(function () {
                    if (queryIndex === length) {
                        setTimeout(erasePlaceHolder, 1000);

                        clearInterval(typingTimer);
                    } else {
                        const currentPlaceholderValue =
                            searchInputBox.getAttribute("placeholder");
                        searchInputBox.setAttribute(
                            "placeholder",
                            currentPlaceholderValue + phrase.charAt(queryIndex)
                        );

                        queryIndex++;
                    }
                }, 100);
            };

            const erasePlaceHolder = function () {
                const currentPlaceholderValue =
                    searchInputBox.getAttribute("placeholder");
                const length = currentPlaceholderValue.length;
                let queryIndex = length - 1;
                typingTimer = setInterval(function () {
                    if (queryIndex === -1) {
                        clearInterval(typingTimer);
                        index++;
                        if (index === placeHolderPhrases.length) {
                            index = 0;
                        }
                        setTimeout(updatePlaceHolder, 1000);
                    } else {
                        const newPlaceholderValue = currentPlaceholderValue.slice(
                            0,
                            queryIndex
                        );
                        searchInputBox.setAttribute("placeholder", newPlaceholderValue);
                        queryIndex--;
                    }
                }, 50);
            };
            updatePlaceHolder();
        }
    });
})

How should I apply Mamaearth Vitamin C Daily Glow Face Serum for the best results?

Using Mamaearth Vitamin C Daily Glow Face Serum daily helps boost natural radiance, fade dark spots, reduce dullness, and improve overall skin tone. What is the difference between Ethyl Ascorbic Acid and L-Ascorbic Acid in terms of stability and skin absorption?

Ethyl Ascorbic Acid is a more stable and water-soluble derivative of Vitamin C compared to L-Ascorbic Acid. It resists oxidation, penetrates the skin effectively, and delivers lasting brightness. L-Ascorbic Acid tends to oxidize quickly, reducing its potency and absorption over time.

Why is Ethyl Ascorbic Acid considered a more stable form of Vitamin C in skincare serums?

Ethyl Ascorbic Acid remains stable even when exposed to light and air, making it ideal for skincare serums like Mamaearth’s Vitamin C Daily Glow Face Serum. Its stability ensures consistent antioxidant activity and deeper skin absorption for a visible glow and even skin tone.

For optimal results, use Mamaearth Vitamin C Daily Glow Face Serum twice a day – morning and night. In the morning, pair it with sunscreen. At night, apply it with a moisturizer. This twice-daily routine helps maintain a consistent glow and protects your skin from daily damage.

Will Mamaearth Vitamin C Daily Glow Face Serum work on dark spots and uneven skin tone?

Yes, regular use of Mamaearth Vitamin C Daily Glow Face Serum helps fade dark spots and correct uneven skin tone. The presence of Vitamin C accelerates skin cell turnover and lightens pigmentation, while Niacinamide supports a more balanced, clear complexion.

Can I use Mamaearth Vitamin C Daily Glow Face Serum along with sunscreen or moisturizer?

Yes. Apply the Vitamin C serum first, allow it to absorb for a minute or two, then follow up with your moisturizer. In the daytime, always finish your routine with a broad-spectrum sunscreen to lock in the benefits and protect your skin from UV damage.

Does Mamaearth Vitamin C Daily Glow Face Serum have any side effects?

This serum is free from parabens, sulfates, and harmful chemicals, making it safe for all skin types. Side effects are rare but may include mild tingling or redness, especially for very sensitive skin. To be safe, do a patch test before full-face application if you're using it for the first time.
